033d20a96f0b0a3584a382f400f72b3db32f0370.summary: BleepingComputer reports that the ALPHV/BlackCat ransomware gang shut down its servers and negotiation sites in early March 2024. This followed an alleged affiliate's claim that the gang kept a $22 million ransom Optum paid after the Change Healthcare attack. The affiliate says it still holds 4TB of Optum data. The report says it is unclear whether this is an exit scam or a rebrand. It recounts the gang's history from DarkSide in 2020 through BlackMatter, and notes an FBI operation that obtained decryption keys and helped more than 400 victims recover data.
